items.caption: A modern redraw of 路 in Shuowen seal-script style, showing the received form associated with the analysis of 足 and 各.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 路, with a rounded loop at upper left, a squared loop at upper right, and long descending strokes.
items.selection_reason: The visible glyph is legible and identified as 路 in seal-script style. It provides a useful graphic comparison for the received Shuowen analysis, though it does not establish how the character developed from earlier forms.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact image. The available evidence does not establish a complete sequence of graphic changes leading to the modern form.
